summary: A twin-engine business jet about 20 m long: a lofted round-section fuselage with a drooped nose and dark wrap… joints door, wing_aileron_l, wing_aileron_r, fin_rudder, stabiliser_elevator_l, stabiliser_elevator_r, …; options stripe; sockets eye_point, door_step.
